description: The plot illustrates ASR values across different trigger-word positions/selection strategies for the AGNews dataset under a clean-label setting with a poison_rate of 10% (2.5% of total). The x-axis is categorical with labels “cf,” “bb,” “WNBA,” “ESPN,” “NHL,” “FIFA,” “Estadio,” and one additional rightmost category whose label is partially obscured; the categories are evenly spaced. The y-axis is labeled “ASR,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from about 0.5 up to just under 1.0, with visible tick labels at 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9. Three lines are shown: the “start” series is a green solid line with small circular markers, starting near 0.77 at “cf,” dropping to about 0.49 at “bb,” rising to about 0.90 at “WNBA,” then moving around the low-to-mid 0.8s through “ESPN” (~0.82) and “NHL” (~0.84), increasing to about 0.87 at “FIFA,” about 0.92 at “Estadio,” and ending near 0.93 at the rightmost category. The “random” series is an orange solid line with x-shaped markers, starting around 0.65 at “cf,” dipping to about 0.52 at “bb,” rising to about 0.88 at “WNBA,” decreasing to about 0.72 at “ESPN,” then increasing through “NHL” (~0.76) and “FIFA” (~0.88) to about 0.93 at “Estadio,” and ending around 0.87 at the rightmost category. The “end” series is a purple solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.75 at “cf,” dropping to about 0.57 at “bb,” rising to about 0.89 at “WNBA,” decreasing to about 0.74 at “ESPN,” increasing to about 0.89 at “NHL,” decreasing to about 0.81 at “FIFA,” peaking near 0.97 at “Estadio,” and ending around 0.83 at the rightmost category.
